scripts.infra:up: cd infra && docker-compose up -d postgres redis
scripts.dev:android: pnpm infra:up && pnpm db:wait && pnpm server:migrate && pnpm server:seed && concurrently -k -n "server,flutter" "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm flutter:run:android"
scripts.prod:up: cd infra && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml up -d --build
scripts.prod:down: cd infra && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml down
scripts.prod:logs: cd infra && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml logs -f server
scripts.prod:migrate: cd infra && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml exec server npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prod:seed: cd infra && docker-compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.server.yml exec server npx prisma db seed
